title: Automated DNA/RNA Extractions from Stony Coral Using ZymoBIOMICS Kit
author: Benjamin D Young
materials: All coral samples were stored in 2ml cryo vial tubes ( Thermofisher Nalgene 2ml Cryo Vial Tubes ) with 1.5ml of RNA later ( Thermofisher RNAlater ) at -80 o C.

During bead beating step, prep the consumables and reagents needed for the Kingfisher DNA parallel protocol. DeepWell plates - Tip plate - Tip comb - Consumable and Reagent Prep for KingFisher Flex DNA Parallel Protocol. Make sure all reagents are prepared accordingly following ZymoBIOMICS protocol - DNA/RNA Wash 1 and 2 are concentrates and require addition of isopropanol.

steps.title: Sterilize tools and bench
steps.instruction: Clean bonecutters and tweezers with 80 % bleach, then flame‑sterilize with 70 % ethanol; clean bench space between each sample with 80 % bleach followed by 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Thaw samples and prep bead tubes
steps.instruction: Thaw stored coral samples at room temperature for 45 minutes. While thawing, fill each Zymo Bashingbead Lysis tube with 750 µL DNA/RNA Shield.

steps.title: Transfer coral to bead tubes
steps.instruction: Remove coral skeletons from cryovials and place them into the pre‑filled Zymo bead‑beating tubes (750 µL DNA/RNA Shield). Between each coral sample, bleach and flame‑sterilize tools with 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Bead‑beat samples
steps.instruction: Secure up to 18 tubes per Genie 2 vortex with the 24‑tube holder attachment and bead‑beat for 30 minutes (maximum vortex speed).

steps.title: Reconstitute Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Reconstitute lyophilized Proteinase K according to the ZymoBIOMICS protocol and store aliquots at –20 °C.

steps.title: Reconstitute DNase
steps.instruction: Reconstitute DNase following the ZymoBIOMICS protocol, store aliquots at –20 °C; use 2.3 mL DNase/RNase‑free water per vial (1 vial = 2.3 mL, 2 vials for a 96‑well plate = 4.6 mL).

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the bead‑beating tubes for 30 seconds at 10 000 g, then transfer 200 µL of supernatant from each tube to a KingFisher deep‑well plate (the sample plate).

steps.title: Store remaining lysate
steps.instruction: Leave the remaining 550 µL DNA/RNA Shield, beads, and coral tissue in the original tubes and store at –80 °C indefinitely for future use.

steps.title: Add lysis reagents and beads
steps.instruction: To each well containing 200 µL supernatant, add 10 µL reconstituted Proteinase K, 500 µL DNA/RNA Lysis Buffer, and 30 µL ZymoBIOMICS MagBinding beads.

steps.title: Run KingFisher DNA Parallel protocol
steps.instruction: Initiate the KingFisher DNA Parallel Protocol on the KingFisher Flex instrument and load all plates exactly as instructed by the machine (BindIT script R2135_ZymoBIOMICS DNARNA Magbead_KingFisherFlex_DNA Parallel Purification_wPause_v2‑2.bdz).

steps.title: Pause after binding – handle RNA plate
steps.instruction: When the KingFisher Flex pauses after the initial binding step, remove the sample plate (which now contains the cleared lysate) for later RNA extraction; seal the plate and either place it on ice (if RNA will be extracted the same day) or store at –20 °C (short‑term) or –80 °C (long‑term).

steps.title: Elute DNA and store
steps.instruction: After the DNA Parallel run finishes, place the elution plate on a magnetic stand for 3 minutes to allow residual beads to settle, then transfer the supernatant to a new 96‑well PCR plate, seal, and store at –80 °C. Optionally aliquot ~6 µL to a separate plate for QC (Nanodrop, Qubit, TapeStation).

steps.title: Equilibrate RNA plate before RNA prep
steps.instruction: Remove the sealed RNA‑sample plate from ice, let it sit at room temperature for 15 minutes, then vortex gently.

steps.title: Prepare RNA input with ethanol and beads
steps.instruction: Transfer 350 µL of the supernatant to a new KingFisher deep‑well plate, add 350 µL of 95‑100 % ethanol and 30 µL MagBinding beads; reseal the original sample plate and store it at –80 °C (remaining volume ≈350 µL) for possible repeat RNA extractions.

steps.title: Run KingFisher RNA Parallel protocol
steps.instruction: Start the KingFisher RNA Parallel Protocol on the Flex instrument using the BindIT script R2135_ZymoBIOMICS DNARNA Magbead_KingFisherFlex_RNA Parallel_350 µL input_wPause_v2‑2.bdz, loading all plates as directed.

substeps.instruction: When the instrument pauses after Ethanol Wash 2, add the pre‑prepared DNase plate (see DNase preparation step) and resume the run.
After the DNase digestion pause, add 500 µL DNA/RNA Prep Buffer to each well manually, then resume.
When a further pause occurs to replace consumable deep‑well plates with fresh reagents, swap the plates and resume.

steps.title: Elute RNA and store
steps.instruction: Upon completion of the RNA Parallel run, place the elution plate on a magnetic stand for 3 minutes, transfer the supernatant to a new 96‑well PCR plate, aliquot ~5 µL to a separate plate for QC, seal both plates, and store at –80 °C until downstream processing.
